findings.evidenceJa: 桜か遠坂に調理法を教わったのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Sakura or Rin taught Illya how to cook it.
findings.explanation: The English silently removes Sakura as one of the two possible teachers.

findings.highlight: treated just like the other mysterious comas
findings.evidenceJa: 原因不明の集団中毒と同一視される
findings.governingReading: The incident is being grouped with the unexplained mass-poisoning cases.
findings.explanation: The English changes the public classification from unexplained mass poisoning to other comas, collapsing reported cause-category and symptom.

findings.evidenceJa: いまも病院に運ばれている
findings.governingReading: The more-than-one-hundred victims are still being transported to hospitals as the report airs.
findings.explanation: The English omits the continuing emergency transport of victims.

findings.evidenceJa: 今までとは段違いの犠牲者が出た
findings.governingReading: Casualties have occurred on a scale categorically beyond anything before.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the unprecedented leap in casualty scale to the bare fact that there are more victims.

findings.highlight: a whole section of the town will be swallowed
findings.evidenceJa: 一区画まるごと呑み込まれかねない
findings.governingReading: At this rate there is a serious risk that an entire district could be swallowed within days.
findings.explanation: The English promotes Rin’s forecasted possibility into a certain future event.

findings.evidenceJa: 布で巻かれた左腕を、強く握り締めていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou discovers that he has been gripping his cloth-wrapped left arm tightly and unconsciously.
findings.explanation: The English produces a malformed present-tense fragment and omits both the wrapping and force of the grip.

findings.governingReading: Shirou asks for confirmation that the missing people were killed.
findings.explanation: The English removes the agency and violence of killing, asking only whether they are dead.
